description: The Ciscomani for Congress campaign today released a new ad, " Radical Allies ", turning JoAnna Mendoza’s support from failed, unpopular Tucson Mayor Regina Romero against her, highlighting her radical positions on public safety that have earned her this endorsement.
title: NEW AD: JoAnna Mendoza’s Radical Agenda Earns Her the Support of Failed Tucson Mayor Regina Romero — Juan Ciscomani for Congress
